scenes.title: Night 1 Hotel-Style Sleep Suite: Right Hemisphere Sleeps While Left Hemisphere Snaps Hand to Bedside Switch
scenes.era: 2016 Brown University Sleep & Vision Laboratory two-night neuroimaging suite

layout.description: Clean architectural hotel-style sleep suite with a crisp white platform bed at center, warm walnut nightstand holding a brushed-metal tactile response button on the right, and a recessed observation glass window on the left.

positions.who: Adult business traveler sleeper (45-year-old stylized 2.5D vinyl character in slate-blue buttoned cotton pajama shirt wearing soft acoustic sleep earphones)
positions.where: lying supine on the crisp white hotel mattress with right hand resting inches from the walnut nightstand switch
positions.facing: upward angled slightly toward the walnut nightstand

positions.who: Sleep neuroscientist (stylized 2.5D vinyl character in tailored navy blazer over crisp white lab coat holding a physical brass stopwatch and clipboard)
positions.where: standing beside the observation glass timing the exact moment the sleeper's hand strikes the bedside button
positions.facing: angled toward the sleeper and bedside switch

props.name: Brushed-aluminum bedside tactile response button on walnut nightstand
props.period_detail: heavy mechanical laboratory plunger switch wired to a cloth-braided cord with zero digital screens
props.physical_behavior: State A resting unpressed beside the sleeper's still fingers -> State B briskly slammed downward by the sleeper's right index finger the instant an oddball earphone chime arrives

props.name: Crisp unfamiliar hotel pillow paired with soft acoustic sleep earphones
props.period_detail: stiff bright-white hotel percale pillow slip and minimal white acoustic ear tubes
props.physical_behavior: State A sleeper's head rests lightly tilted toward the right ear -> State B head snaps upright off the pillow as eyes pop wide open at a faint hallway sound

actions.verb_sequence: breathes shallowly on the unfamiliar white hotel pillow -> snaps eyes wide open at an oddball right-ear tone and slams right index finger onto the mechanical bedside button

reactions.reaction: clicks the mechanical brass stopwatch and nods as the immediate Night-1 button strike confirms left-hemisphere sentinel vigilance

scenes.wardrobe: Sleeper in slate-blue buttoned cotton pajama top; researcher in crisp white lab coat over dark charcoal knit.
scenes.lighting: Cool moonlit hotel-bedroom rim light balanced with clean architectural key lighting.
scenes.recognition_hook: Exhausted in a quiet hotel bed, yet snapping wide awake three times faster because half your brain refuses to go off duty on Night 1!

key_visual.description: an adult sleeper in slate-blue pajamas snapping awake on a crisp white hotel bed and slamming a mechanical bedside response button while a researcher clicks a brass stopwatch

scenes.title: Outdoor Morning Terrace Café After Night 1 vs Night 2 Travel Recovery
scenes.era: Modern sunlit morning hotel sidewalk café patio

layout.description: Sunlit outdoor cobblestone sidewalk café outside a city hotel with wrought-iron bistro tables, potted olive trees, and morning commuters walking past in golden sunlight.

positions.who: Adult business traveler (in camel wool coat with rolling carry-on suitcase beside outdoor bistro chair)
positions.where: seated outdoors at a sunlit sidewalk table pulling a folded oatmeal-linen home pillowcase from an open weekender bag
positions.facing: three-quarter view toward the sunlit street

props.name: Ceramic espresso cup and folded oatmeal-linen home pillowcase inside leather weekender bag
props.period_detail: textured natural home linen contrasted against crisp hotel luggage tag
props.physical_behavior: traveler lifts ceramic coffee cup steady-handed in bright morning sun after packing the familiar home pillowcase into the top zip pocket

actions.verb_sequence: steps out of hotel revolving doors into bright morning sunlight -> tucks familiar oatmeal-linen pillowcase into carry-on bag and lifts warm espresso cup with calm focus

reactions.reaction: relaxes shoulders in warm outdoor morning light knowing Night 2 brings symmetric deep recovery

scenes.wardrobe: Tailored camel wool travel coat over oxford shirt.
scenes.lighting: Crisp golden outdoor morning sunlight with natural tree shadows.
scenes.recognition_hook: Stepping outside after a fragmented first hotel night—and packing your own home pillowcase so Night 1 feels safe from the start.

scenes.title: Night 2 Familiar Pillow Reset: Symmetric Deep Sleep Without Flinching

layout.description: Warm minimal hotel bedroom where the traveler slips a familiar oatmeal-linen home pillowcase onto the hotel pillow beside an untouched bedside switch.

positions.where: seated on the edge of the bed smoothing the oatmeal-linen pillowcase flat before sinking deeply into rest
positions.facing: toward the pillow and warm bedside lamp

props.name: Oatmeal-linen home pillowcase slipped over hotel pillow
props.period_detail: soft washed home fabric replacing stiff unfamiliar hotel percale
props.physical_behavior: hands slide the linen slip smoothly over the pillow and click the warm brass bedside lamp switch off

actions.verb_sequence: pulls familiar linen pillowcase over the hotel pillow -> switches off the brass lamp and sinks deeply into stillness with motionless hands

reactions.reaction: breathes slowly and evenly without flinching when a distant hallway door clicks

scenes.lighting: Warm amber bedside lamp clicking into calm moonlit rest.
scenes.recognition_hook: Once your brain recognizes the room as safe, your left-hemisphere sentinel stands down and both halves sleep deeply.
